# Generated conformance fixtures

Original synthetic images generated with Pillow 12.3.0 (PNG and libwebp encoders).
8 x 6 transparent canvases, four coloured rectangles, partial alpha and delta
rectangles. APNG exercises source/over and background/previous disposal; poster.apng
excludes a yellow default PNG from the animation. Durations: 40, 90, 120, 70 ms.
expected.json contains Pillow composite pixels and SHA-256 of each source.
These test assets are provided under the repository MIT license.

APNG composition is independently verified with Chromium WebCodecs (Chromium
156.0.8078.4, Playwright build 1248), stored in chromium.json. Pillow's alpha-over compositing and the
Flutter SDK's Skia APNG previous-disposal/default-poster handling disagree on
these inputs; they are not used as the APNG pixel oracle. WebP uses Pillow.

The Flutter 3.47.9 Skia animation decoder also fails an opaque-to-partial-alpha
WebP transition generated by both libwebp and Animcodec. Native output tests
start with partial alpha; Focale's Chromium worker test separately checks the
opaque-to-partial-alpha transition for both new formats. Focale imports frames
through Animcodec rather than this platform decoder.

lossy.webp uses libwebp quality 80 with a separate ALPH plane. The WebP pixel
oracle allows an RGB difference of at most three for YUV rounding; alpha is exact.
